cases.name: poll only cannot guarantee transient edge recovery
best effort push is only a wake hint
complete durable replay supports bounded authenticated recovery
retention shorter than disconnect horizon degrades claim
missing partition sequence or high watermark disables replay claim
issuer scope and key revocation checks are required for provenance
signature presence without verification is not authenticated provenance
current sink permission revision is a separate requirement
poll interval cannot be attached to a push source
signed best-effort push does not imply event recall
high watermark without stable event identity is incomplete

limitations: In-memory profile classifier; no live source probe, authentication or production adapter is exercised.
Capability declarations are integration-owner inputs and can drift; production use needs conformance probes and signed profile/version receipts.
